bundle.shortDescription: Notes in Markdown or AsciiDoc, shared with AI agents
bundle.longDescription: A note-taking app for notes that are plain Markdown or AsciiDoc files in a workspace directory, kept in the layout of a GitHub or GitLab wiki. Edit a note in its markup or in the facade, a rendered editing view; work with git; and let an AI agent read and write the same notes through an MCP server.
